ruleset.name: Spocket formatting baseline
ruleset.description:
Formatting-only PHPCS ruleset for the lint/style baseline.
It inherits phpcs.xml so it keeps the project's WordPress conventions (tab indent, brace placement, concatenation spacing), then narrows the run to sniffs whose fixes only change whitespace and layout. Inheriting matters: a standalone ruleset falls back to PSR-style 4-space defaults and would reindent the whole tree away from WPCS.
Why this is not just phpcs.xml: phpcs.xml is the full WPCS/WooCommerce review standard. Most of what it reports is either not auto-fixable (missing docblock tags, unsanitised input) or is a token-level rewrite rather than layout, so running phpcbf with it would put behaviour-adjacent edits into a formatting-only commit.
The baseline commit was verified token-by-token against the pre-format tree (token_get_all with whitespace and comments filtered): all 15 files came back identical except for 10 trailing commas added by NormalizedArrays.Arrays.CommaAfterLast, which are inert in PHP.
Deliberately EXCLUDED, for the behaviour-changing follow-up PR: Universal.Arrays.DisallowShortArraySyntax (9) [] -> array() Modernize.FunctionCalls.Dirname (5) dirname(__FILE__) -> __DIR__ Universal.UseStatements.NoLeadingBackslash (2) use \Foo; -> use Foo; All three are semantically identical rewrites, but they edit tokens rather than layout, so they do not belong in a formatting commit.
